prompt.title: See where you stand on the growth continuum
prompt.text: You grow from leaning on others, to standing on your own, to teaming up. Rate where you are in a few parts of your life. Come back in a month to see what's changed.
prompt.glossText: The book calls the three stages dependence, independence and interdependence.
prompt.whyItMatters: Where you stand shows which habits to work on next. Still leaning on others? Build your own footing first. Already on your own feet? Work on teaming up.

history.empty: No assessments yet. Start your first one.

1.title: Dependence
1.description: You count on other people, or on luck, to get results here.

2.title: Independence
2.description: You rely on your own effort and judgement to get results here.

3.title: Interdependence
3.description: You team up with others here, and you both come out ahead.

form.notePlaceholder: e.g. I still wait for my manager to tell me what to focus on.
form.removeConfirmBody: Its rating and note will be lost. You'll have a few seconds to undo it.

areas.title: Which areas do you want to rate?
areas.hint: Pick as many as you like. You'll rate them one at a time.
areas.customPrompt: Is there another part of your life you want to rate?
areas.requiredHint: Choose at least one area to continue.
areas.duplicateError: That area is already on the list.

result.profilePending: Rate at least one area to see your overall picture.

checklist.rated: Rate every area in one assessment

guide.inShort: You'll pick a few parts of your life, like work, family and money. For each, you'll say if you wait for others, handle it yourself, or team up. About ten minutes. You'll end with an overall picture, and the habits to work on next.
howTo: Tap "New assessment", then pick the areas you want to rate.
Add your own area if one's missing, then tap "Continue".
For each area, pick the answer that fits best right now.
If it helps you remember, add a note on why.
Look at your overall profile and the habits it points to.
Tap "Mark done" once every area in the assessment is rated.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: I wait for others (Dependence). Note: "I still wait for my manager to tell me what to focus on."

guide.afterwards: Do it again in a month and compare. The app shows what changed since last time. Until then, start with the areas where you still wait for others.
